name: learned-scalar-complex-recurrence-five-case-three-seed-v1
model: CM95/96 complete learned scalar complex recurrence and convex function mixtures
interface: immutable object sequence to next original object; IDs are addresses only
data: unchanged original frozen35 native generators; fixed data seed1, three independent training sampler/component seeds
budget_rule: fixed label-independent total component mass; every scalar operator has norm at most one
component_starts: trainable identity initialization, random full complex unit scalars, previous learned proposal when available
component_search: initial state and every observed-object transition; four real/imaginary disk-projected perturbations, radius 2*2^(-sweep); fit all readouts to complete CE scalar signals; accept only strict full-batch CE decrease at alpha=min(0.1,1/budget)
sampler: all original minibatch records, duplicate occurrences and short tails; Random(seed+10000)
training: ordinary full-class CE; same feasible query centre; forward mode uses finite loss queries without CE or recurrent derivatives
stopping: fixed updates, all30 endpoints sealed before held-out scoring
success: original primary success plus separate raw/exact99; retain every original split
limitations: scalar recurrence is permutation-invariant; no general MQAR claim; approximate discovery has no global convergence guarantee; parity lengths are separate original training tasks, not extrapolation of a parity16 endpoint
